source_policy: Use exact-title scholarly discovery, then verify venue and metadata against an official conference, publisher, DOI, or preprint record. Do not promote a search-result venue without primary-source confirmation.
dataset_policy: Record separately the datasets used for self-supervised or backbone pretraining and the datasets used for downstream evaluation. Preserve named benchmark suites and explicitly label unnamed private collections.

records.normalized_title: unsupervised representation learning by sorting sequences

updates.method_description: A Siamese CNN extracts features from every pair in a shuffled frame tuple and predicts its chronological permutation, using motion-aware sampling, spatial jittering, and channel splitting to suppress shortcuts.
updates.dataset_notes: The main model is self-supervised on UCF101 and transferred to UCF101, HMDB51, and PASCAL VOC 2007. The paper also reports dataset-specific unsupervised pretraining on HMDB51.
previous_titles: Unsupervised representation learning by sorting sequences

records.normalized_title: self supervised video representation learning with odd one out networks

updates.method_description: A multi-branch CNN receives several temporally ordered subsequences and one frame-shuffled subsequence from the same video, then learns to identify the odd input through shared encoders and feature fusion.
updates.dataset_notes: Self-supervised feature learning and downstream action classification are reported on UCF101 and HMDB51 without external pretrained weights or optical-flow inputs.
previous_titles: Self-supervised video representation learning with odd-one-out networks
